b: I know there are lots of similar posts, but I haven't seen anyone with such a weird problem: in August 2025 I started a community project (an events guide) using two domains: a blog-style webpage with each weekly edition in PDF and HTML formats, and a single-page calendar application.
I tried everything I could think of.. Improving meta tags, titles, adding sitemaps. But 16 months later and I have ONE page indexed in one domain, and ZERO in the other!

They have some backlinks, not many but they are there and Google does not even list them. If I search for the name of the project, or even the domain name, the social media profiles of the project appear, as well as other sites that are scraping my content and linking to my site.
I really don't know what else to try, so I would really appreciate any suggestions you might have. Thanks a mil.
